services.name: Birthday Parties at Waterloo
services.desc: Celebrate your special day with an unforgettable pool party at our state-of-the-art facility with our heated, indoor pools. Perfect for year-round fun, our birthday parties offer excitement, laughter, and memories that will last a lifetime. Dive in and let the celebration begin! When?: Birthday Parties are held on Saturday evenings after 5:30pm and all day Sundays! Where?: Right now we are only hosting Birthdays are our Central facility (3200 W Anderson Ln) and Round Rock facility (751 Phillip Warner Pl, Round Rock, TX 78665). Cost?: Your party rental is 2 hours for $400. Your birthday package includes but is not limited

blurb: Waterloo has been such a productive and encouraging experience for all three of my children over the last four years! The teachers have created a swim culture that not only supports safe swimming practices but, most importantly, a true love of the water and the sport. Each coach we have had has been just as dedicated to my swimmer who is in Swim Fit as they are to my youngest, who is just starting purple.
